overview: A full-featured WhatsApp Automation Dashboard for managing multiple WhatsApp accounts, bulk messaging campaigns, contacts, and analytics — with support for connecting to a real external Node.js backend.
features: Configure external Node.js backend URL from Settings to enable real WhatsApp connections
WhatsApp Clients page shows real QR codes and client status from the external backend
Clear setup guidance when backend is not yet configured
Campaigns with scheduling, execution, pause, and cancel
Contact list management with CSV import
Message history with filtering and pagination
Analytics charts for daily messages, campaign performance, and contacts growth
Settings for daily limits, delays, active hours, and backend URL
